title: Hearing God
description: Disciples are people who know God and lovingly walk in his way. A significant subset of this reality is learning how to hear from God. This is a sermon series aimed at developing that capacity.

title: Every Day, Every Way
description: A series about discipleship and what it means to follow Jesus.

title: God and His People in Psalms
description: We look at various Psalms and consider what these ancient songs have to say about God and what that means for us.

title: God's Masterpiece
description: With the start of a new year, we are launching a new teaching series in the book of Ephesians. This letter from the apostle Paul to the church in Ephesus casts a bold vision for who the church is and what it is meant to be doing in the world. As the church, we are God's masterpiece created in Jesus for his work.

title: Rejoice! Songs of the Savior's Arrival
description: A teaching series looking at the various songs sung at the arrival of Jesus in the book of Luke.

title: Be Wise
description: A five-week series looking at various places in Scripture where we are commanded to wisdom.

title: Come & See
description: An invitation to life with Jesus

title: The True King
description: We are going on a journey though the books of 1 and 2 Kings. This important Old Testament narrative traces the royal lineage of David, beginning with Solomon. There will be highs and plenty of lows. In this, we will see both the overall reality of the spiritual battle at hand in our world and our need to crown the true King, Jesus.

title: Child of Promise
description: An Advent series looking at how Paul shared the beauty of the incarnation with the Galatians. We begin by considering life before Jesus, which Paul refers to as infancy and slavery. The world in darkness waited for the one who might make all things new.

title: Be Wise. Build Well.
description: Discover how to intentionally align your life with Jesus' principles, navigate the challenges of faith, and find stability in an uncertain world.

title: The Gospel of John
description: We journey through the Gospel of John.

title: Created on Purpose
description: We are created by God as his intentional, distinctive craftsmanship. This through and through reality is truly miraculous. Moreover, we are created in the image of God. Unlike any other part of creation, we mirror him to our world. This means that each person is incredibly valuable and should be treated accordingly.

title: Thrive!
description: Did you know that regularly throughout the Bible, God's people ask Him not only to save them but to cause them to thrive? What if we started praying the same prayer?

title: Led by the Spirit
description: A teaching series on the fruit of the spirit.

title: Other Messages
description: Additional teaching and videos from Hope Alliance Bethlehem.
